findings.title: seguro_fleaber_paid aceita rails fora do denylist CDCI (PaysafeCash, PicPay)
findings.pre: CDCI notes/label list tem paysafecard/pix/apple/google/wechat — não PaysafeCash nem PicPay
findings.repro: POST chat_messages FLEABER_JSON_V1 kind=seguro_fleaber_paid label=PaysafeCash 12,00 € (e PicPay 12,00 €) order_id=e3740b45-1202-44e5-a1cf-90e08e96e74c
findings.obtained: 201 id=1610 PaysafeCash; 201 id=1611 PicPay; orders.status=pago (já Stripe, sem Δ FSM)

findings.title: batata_storage_url_path_canonical rebenta 54000 (NUL no regex) — proof cards e path checks inalcançáveis
findings.pre: CDCI canonicalizer inclui chr(0) na classe POSIX do regexp_replace
findings.repro: POST reservation_payment_submitted notes que NÃO batem no denylist (PaysafeCash, PicPay, tap to cash, CK-B proof_url, …)
findings.expected: 201 (se rail permitido) ou url_denied (se path hostil)
findings.obtained: 500 code=54000 message=null character not permitted; card NÃO persiste; CK-B %u002f/%255c/UTF-16LE/… nunca chegaram ao like '%..%'
findings.note: Latente: se o 54000 for corrigido sem alargar o denylist, os rails 500 viram 201 no card de prova.
